description: How a niche moved over a window we have already archived, grouped by item: where each account stood then and where it stands now. This is the question nobody can answer after the fact — nobody photographs the past retroactively. Call `archive_coverage` first for the valid niche ids and how far back the archive goes. `from` and `to` are ISO 8601; without them you get the last 7 days, and the archive caps any window at 90 days. Requires an API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` — free key at https://honesthook.com/docs#key; costs 1 credit — charged even when the result is empty.

from.description: Start of the window, ISO 8601 (`2026-09-05T00:00:00Z`). Optional. Anything else answers 400 rather than being guessed at.

limit.description: How many items to return. Optional.

niche.description: The niche id, as `archive_coverage` returns it — for example `ai-agents`. A niche we do not archive is refused by the API.

to.description: End of the window, ISO 8601. Optional, defaults to now.

name: archive_trends
title: Niche trend history
